profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary:
Over 8+ years of experience in web development, I design, spec, develop, & integrate features, services, & APIs for web applications.

I have used a long list of different technologies, but my main tech-stack is:
- ReactJS
- NextJS
- NodeJS
- Jest & TestCafe
- Typescript

I also have Native Android Experience, but it is not my main focus right now.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
I contributed to the development of teechip.com, being owner of:
- Holding high standards and ensuring best practices.
- Ensuring the delivery of features, from requirements gathering to production release.
- Tracking, assessing, preventing, and seeing through technical debt.

I used technologies such as ReactJS, TypeScript, MongoDB, ElasticSearch, & NodeJS.

positions.title: Software Engineer ll
positions.description:
As a Software Engineer II, I embraced the DevOps culture to deliver products in the fastest and most reliable way. To accomplish this, I adopted the "Shift-Left" testing methodology to ensure the quality of our products.

I was in charge of:
- Holding high standards and ensuring best practices.
- Track, assess, & prevent technical debt.

I worked with technologies such as ReactJS, NextJS, NodeJS, TestCafe, Jest, CircleCI, Jenkins, among others.

positions.title: Software Engineer l
positions.description:
As a Software Engineer I, I ensured high-leverage contributions to different projects.

I was a full-stack developer using technologies such as ReactJS, NextJS, NodeJS, & Jest.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: As an intern, my main focus was to get experience from my peers and learn as much as possible web development with technologies such as ReactJS for the frontend and NodeJS for the backend.

positions.title: Android Developer
positions.description:
I worked as a Native Android Developer and I contributed to the development of:
- BELMovil
- PagoMovil
- Busolinea
- BeaconIO
